comparison_scope: original24DEV plus16R2; retiredR1 is diagnostic-only and excluded from this formal comparison corpus
composition: 16 reserve resources, eight positive families with one observed primary and one realistic distractor each, eight positive and two unsupported-fact queries; 2PDF/2DOCX/2ODT/10text-family files
measurement_unit: unique logical document with pinned content revision, not chunk
reserve_visibility: steward-only; no candidate execution until explicit root GO
selection_note: questions and grades fixed before baseline measurement; no selection or difficulty changes based on scores

thresholds.ndcg_at_10: candidate >= baseline using frozen graded relevance
thresholds.recall_at_5: mean(|R intersect top5 unique documents| / |R|) over positive queries
